description: Turn plain lines into a clean bulleted list with your choice of bullet symbol.

faqs.a: • bullet, – dash, * asterisk, → arrow and ✓ check mark.
One bullet per non-empty line; blank lines are skipped.
Blank lines are skipped, so pasting a spaced-out list still produces a clean result.

howto: Press Format and copy the list.
title: Bullet Point Formatter
